name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd
about: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd is one of the largest low-income housing finance companies in India servicing the home financing needs of the low income sections of the society. [1]
keyPoints: Focus on Low-Income Financing[1] Aadhar Housing Finance is a housing finance company (HFC) focused on the low-income housing segment with a ticket size of < Rs 15 lakh. The average ticket size of loans was Rs 10 lakh, with an average loan-to-value of 58.3% end of December 2023.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 26.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
